title: Sumitomo Metal Mining Develops and Ships Samples of a 300mm Bonded SiC Substrate: What It Means for Mass Production
excerpt: On September 18, 2026, Sumitomo Metal Mining announced the development and sample shipment of "SiCkrest," a 300mm bonded SiC substrate. A beginner-friendly look at how the two-layer structure works, the aim of larger diameters, and the open questions on the road to mass production.
